newsitem.title: USA: Canandaigua says higher costs affected Q2.
newsitem.headline: Canandaigua says higher costs affected Q2.

text.p: Canandaigua Wine Co Inc said Friday its net income dropped for the second quarter ended August 31 largely because of the higher costs and increased interest expenses related to its acquisition of two liquor brands.

Those costs were partially offset by net income from the Fleischmann and Mr. Boston liquor brands that were acquired in September 1995 and higher net sales in the second quarter, as well as a restructuring charge in the same period a year ago, the company said.

For this year's second quarter, Canandaigua reported net income of $4.9 million, or $0.25 per fully diluted share, compared with net income fo $10.1 million, or $0.50 per fully diluted share, in the same period the prior year.
The higher cost of product sold was related to this year's grape harvest, it said.
